svg.aria-label: Two keyboards from C4 to G4. C4 + E4: 4 semitones, numbered hops 1 to 4 across the black keys. E4 + G4: 3 semitones, numbered hops 1 to 3. Quality words are not used yet.
svg.title: Count the semitones: every key counts

g.text: Count the semitones: every key, black ones too
How to read this graphic: Each arc is one hop to the very next key, whatever its colour.
Count the arcs from the lower note to the upper note; the last number is the total. The
two totals differ (4 and 3) even though both pairs span the letters C D E and E F G.
